answer.says: Here is your wage, Ramesh. The groceries are paid as well. Thank you for the papers; I shall read them while I wait for the breakfast.
answer.thought: The air is hazy, a tangible suspension of dust that mirrors the suspension of my status in the Directorate's file. I have settled the immediate debts of the household, a necessary movement from the abstract claim of ownership to the concrete exchange of value. I must now observe the world's news before I can digest it in my own mind.
